title: OrigamiCP: crease-pattern recovery from images of unfolded sheets
description: Code, synthetic benchmark generator and capture tooling for recovering an origami crease pattern from a single image of the unfolded sheet: the fold-condition checks, the physically-based scan renderer, the mask-to-graph extractor, the graph-level evaluation, and the flip-invariant mountain/valley objective. Every number and figure in the accompanying write-up is produced by a single script over a released checkpoint.
